posts.title: 19 days of listening: what my balcony microphone learned about seattle’s corvids
posts.description: a raspberry pi on my balcony has been listening for 19 days. using birdnet and mfcc voice fingerprinting, it identified 18 individual corvids by voice - mapping their territories, daily schedules, call types, and social bonds across north seattle.

posts.title: raspberry pi 5 wifi rejected by eero: status_code=16 (and what finally fixed it)
posts.description: if you’ve landed here because your raspberry pi 5 refuses to connect to an eero mesh router and your logs are full of CTRL-EVENT-ASSOC-REJECT bssid=00:00:00:00:00:00 status_code=16, i spent several hours on exactly this problem. here’s what i tried, what i learned, and what eventually worked — along with an honest admission that i still don’t […]

posts.title: when it’s software… and when it’s physics
posts.description: When multiple variables change at once, our brains tend to focus on the most interesting explanation. However, the lesson here was clear: the problem was physical, not software-related, and a simple swap fixed everything.
